provenance: Hand-written list for the Topic Desk (assets/js/page/topic-desk-model.js). Drafted by Claude on 2026-10-19 for Ian's review. Every other sentence on the desk is computed from the library's data. A dek states what a topic covers and asks the question the churches answer. It never states an answer, a tradition's position, or Mere Orthodoxy's position. A fault-line row is shown only when every quotation in it is found, word for word, in the article the library maps to the topic. A verse note is a plain textual fact.
